questions.statement: Which verb means to move your body to stay fit and healthy?

options.feedback: Incorrect. Sleep is for rest.
Correct! To exercise is to perform physical activity for health.
Incorrect. This refers to nutrition.
Incorrect. This is a sedentary activity.

questions.explanation:
The student identifies basic vocabulary for healthy living.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which of these is considered a healthy habit?

options.feedback: Incorrect. High sugar is unhealthy.
Correct! Proper rest is essential for health.
Incorrect. This is too much sedentary time.
Incorrect. Breakfast is an important meal.

questions.explanation:
The student identifies specific practices that contribute to a healthy lifestyle.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: "I feel very tired all the time. What should I do?"

options.feedback: Incorrect. Sugar gives a quick spike but doesn't solve chronic tiredness.

options.text: You should sleep more and eat healthy food.
options.feedback: Correct! These are standard recommendations for improving energy levels.
Incorrect. This won't help with being tired.
Incorrect. Hydration is necessary for energy.

questions.explanation:
The student understands and selects appropriate health advice based on a described state.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: "Regular exercise ________ your heart and makes your muscles stronger."

options.feedback: Incorrect. Weakens means to make less strong.
Correct! Exercise makes the heart and muscles stronger.
Incorrect. Exercise doesn't break a healthy heart.
Incorrect. Doesn't fit the context.

questions.explanation:
The student understands the causal relationship between exercise and physical benefits.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: "To stay healthy, you should be active at ________ thirty minutes a day."
questions.context: Talking about frequency of physical activity.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "At most" would limit the healthy activity.
Correct! "At least" indicates the minimum recommended time.
Incorrect. Not the correct expression.
Incorrect. We want more activity, not less.

questions.explanation:
The student applies the expression "at least" in the context of health recommendations.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: According to the text, what is one benefit of 'Wellness Wednesday'?
questions.context:
A description of a school's wellness program.
"Our school has a 'Wellness Wednesday'. Students play sports, practice meditation, and learn about nutrition. It helps them reduce stress and stay focused."

options.feedback: Incorrect. Not mentioned.
Correct! The text explicitly mentions "reduce stress".

options.text: It is only about eating fruit.
options.feedback: Incorrect. It also includes sports and meditation.
Incorrect. It is only on Wednesdays.

questions.explanation:
The student applies reading comprehension skills to identify specific benefits mentioned in a text.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: "If you want to have a healthy lifestyle, you ________ smoke."

options.feedback: Incorrect. Smoking is unhealthy.
Correct! "Shouldn't" is the negative advice for unhealthy habits.
Incorrect. This would be an obligation to do something unhealthy.
Incorrect. Grammatically wrong in this context.

questions.explanation:
The student applies the modal verb "shouldn't" to provide negative health advice.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Is this a balanced and healthy daily schedule?
questions.context:
Analyzing a daily schedule for health.
"7:00 AM: Jogging / 8:00 AM: Fruit breakfast / 1:00 PM: Salad and chicken / 4:00 PM: 2 hours of video games / 9:00 PM: Bedtime"

options.text: Yes, it includes exercise, healthy meals, rest, and a little leisure time.
options.feedback: Correct! It covers multiple pillars of health.

options.text: No, because video games are always unhealthy.
options.feedback: Incorrect. In moderation (2 hours), they can be part of a balanced day.

options.text: No, because there is no lunch.
options.feedback: Incorrect. The 1:00 PM meal is lunch.

options.text: Yes, because jogging is the only thing that matters.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Nutrition and rest are also important.

questions.explanation:
The student analyzes a schedule to determine if it meets the criteria for a balanced lifestyle.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: Identifying the logical result of an unhealthy habit.

options.text: Because I exercise every day, I feel very weak.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Exercise usually makes you feel stronger.

options.text: Because I drink a lot of water, I stay hydrated during sports.
options.feedback: Correct! Logical cause-and-effect relationship.

options.text: Because I sleep only 3 hours, I am very focused in class.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Lack of sleep causes lack of focus.

options.text: Because I eat too much sugar, my teeth are very healthy.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Sugar is bad for teeth.

questions.explanation:
The student analyzes the logical consistency of sentences related to health and habits.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What is the author's main point in this text?
questions.context:
Evaluating an opinion about mental health.
"Health is not just about the body. A healthy lifestyle also includes having positive relationships, managing your time well, and being kind to yourself."

options.text: You only need to exercise to be healthy.
options.feedback: Incorrect. The text says it's "not just about the body".

options.text: Being kind is more important than eating vegetables.
options.feedback: Incorrect. The text suggests a combination, not one over the other.

options.text: A healthy lifestyle is a combination of physical and mental well-being.
options.feedback: Correct! The text emphasizes that health goes beyond the physical aspect.

options.text: Time management is the most difficult part of health.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Not mentioned as "difficult".

questions.explanation: The student evaluates a more complex definition of health that includes mental and social components.
